behavior: Wades in shallow water or walks wet mud, probing deeply with the bill in a rapid sewing-machine motion for buried invertebrates. Often feeds, rests, and preens in peaceful flocks.
field_marks: Chunky, elongated body with a short neck
Very long, straight, dark bill and dark eye
Moderately long olive to yellow-green legs
Breeding plumage mottled brown, black, and gold above, with pale cinnamon underparts and dark spotting or barring
Nonbreeding plumage gray-brown above and pale below, with barred flanks
Long, pointed wings and a short barred tail; white upper rump visible in flight
habitat: Breeds in boreal wetlands near treeline, including bogs, marshes, wet meadows, lake margins, and floodplains. During migration and winter it favors shallow estuaries, lagoons, tidal flats, salt marshes, muddy pond or river margins, flooded fields, and other freshwater or brackish wetlands.
